17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans - 3039 North Kenmore Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 4,654 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change to redevelop the subject property
with a new three-story residential building that will contain three (3)
residential dwelling units. The proposed building will measure 38 ft. The
subject property is a Transit Seved Location and will be supported by four
(4) off-street parking spaces within a detached garage at the rear. Pursuant
to Secs. 17-13-0303-D and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking
requirement for a Transit Served Location from two (2) parking spaces to
four (4) parking spaces and is seeking all additional relief to permit the
attached Type 1 Plan Set.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 5,581 square feet (1.2 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 1,551.33 square feet per D.U.
(3 residential units)

(C)  *The amount of off-street parking: 4 parking spaces (proposed)

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street
parking for a Transit Served Location from the required two (2) parking spaces to
four (4) parking spaces.

(D) Setbacks:
a. FrontSetback: 15 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 4 feet
South Side: 3 feet-6 inches
c. Rear Setback: 34 feet-9 inches

*Pursuant to Secs. 17-13-0303-D and 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking all additional
relief to permit the attached Type 1 Plan Set.

(E) Building Height: 38 feet
